newsitem.title: KENYA: Mombasa port reported operating normally.
newsitem.headline: Mombasa port reported operating normally.

text.p: Officials said on Monday Kenya's port of Mombasa was operating normally despite attacks since Wednesday on the Indian Ocean coast area that have killed more than 30 people.

Alex Kabuga, marketing and public relations officer of Kenya Ports Authority, told Reuters: "The port is operating normally. We have not had people complaining of cancellations of arrivals or delays because of the violence. It is business as usual."

Mombasa is Kenya's second largest city and its main port, a major transit point for goods and produce such as coffee and tea from much of East and Central Africa. It is also at the centre of Kenya's tourism industry.
More than 30 people have been killed in a series of attacks since last Wednesday by attackers, who have concentrated on hitting Kenyans who are not originally from the coast area.
